original.target_description: Experiment 1: paired angry versus neutral central-face reaction-time contrast within the diagnosed GAD group. The replication report explicitly identifies this focal original claim; supplied p. 6 locator corresponds to author-manuscript p. 7 results.

n.sample_role: GAD participants in the within-group paired contrast; not the full three-group sample
n.exclusions: Trials with errors or RT >1500 ms or <200 ms removed; 3.5% of trials excluded across the task. Participant recruitment excluded significant psychiatric comorbidity, addictions, current major physical illness, and current psychological/pharmacological treatment. No additional participant exclusions reported for this contrast.
n.location: Author manuscript p. 5, Experiment 1 Participants; p. 7 Attentional task; Table 1 p. 23

es.location: Author manuscript p. 7, Experiment 1 Results, Attentional task, final sentence continuing to p. 8
es.quote: face was angry compared with neutral, F(1, 13) = 9.35, p < .01, η2p = .42.

p.location: Author manuscript p. 7, Experiment 1 Results, Attentional task
p.quote: face was angry compared with neutral, F(1, 13) = 9.35, p < .01, η2p = .42.

replication.target_description: Verified primary SCORE report Yiend_ClinPsychSci_2015_LmBx - Wilbiks - y2gz6, explicitly evaluating the GAD angry-versus-neutral reaction-time claim. It reports omnibus Group × Valence tests and participant-characteristic comparisons but does not give a GAD angry-versus-neutral test, its effect size, p value, or analytic n. Exact target-test match cannot be established.

n.sample_role: Target GAD participants; analytic sample size not reported in the available replication report
n.location: Claim evaluation; Replication outcome: Complex test

es.location: Claim evaluation; Replication outcome: Complex test

p.location: Claim evaluation; Replication outcome: Complex test

reported_success.quote: The findings observed by Yiend et al. in 2015 were not observed in the present study.

notes: Original title and DOI verified in the supplied frozen cache. Original metric is printed partial eta squared rather than requested Cohen’s f^2; no conversion performed. Replication URL qmbxr is a DOCX file GUID, resolved through the supplied reference project p2st5 and downloaded from https://osf.io/download/qmbxr/. Author report title, replication team and SCORE RR ID match the reference. Omnibus replication statistics were not substituted for the focal paired contrast. The underlying y2gz6 project returned HTTP 410 (no longer available); replication report itself remains available. No generic sample size or original values quoted by the replication source were substituted for direct primary evidence.
